author: GameTrailers
description:
The Sunken Lord awakens. Check out the Once Human: Isles of Abyss launch trailer for this ocean expansion for the survival action game, which brings the ability to craft modular warships; conquer the living ocean where you can brave deadly anomalies across open waters, islands, and the seabed; and you can unite your server to breach The Sunken Lord's beating heart.

In Once Human: Isles of Abyss, the ocean is no longer a backdrop - it’s a sentient predator hunting you. Beneath the unblinking gaze of anomalous lighthouses, how will you survive the deep?

The Isles of Abyss expansion for Once Human is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC, and mobile.

#OnceHumanIslesOfAbyss #Gaming #IGN
title: Once Human: Isles of Abyss - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet your rivals in this latest Fate/Extra Record trailer for the upcoming RPG. These rivals are waiting to take you on in the Moon Holy Grail War. Will you be able to defeat them all? 

Based on Fate/Extra, which was released on the PlayStation Portable in 2010, Fate/Extra Record revises the narrative to add new layers and depth, modernizes the audio-visual presentation, and adds a new strategic battle system that combines turn-based battles with a deck-building system.

Fate/Extra Record will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), and Steam on January 28, 2027.
title: Fate/EXTRA Record - Official Rivals Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea trailer to see what's coming with the new update. Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and set sail on a thrilling new ocean adventure. 


In The Keepsake Sea, befriend five new Villagers and an Adventure Companion, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, Megara, Captain Hook, Wendy, and Dory.

Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea launches on Apple Arcade, the App Store, PC, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch2, PlayStation 4 (PS4) PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on November 18, 2026.
title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea - Official Showcase Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Journey to the colorful world of Loftia and check out gameplay in this trailer from the upcoming life-sim cozy solarpunk MMO. Loftia will be available in Early Access on PC and Mac (Steam and Epic Games Store) on November 3, 2026.

Set across a vibrant world of floating islands, Loftia is designed around community, sustainability, creativity and human connection. Players can build a home, grow crops using sustainable farming systems, rescue animals, take on cooperative adventures, and contribute to large-scale community projects as part of a living world that continues to grow alongside its players.
title: Loftia - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for The Elder Scrolls Online as Season Two: Echoes of Skyrim arrives, featuring new challenges, stories, and treasures in Tamriel's Second Era. Return to the homeland of the Nords in The Elder Scrolls Online as Season Two: Echoes of Skyrim. 

Season Two features over 30 hours of adventures in Skyrim with the Greymoor zone and storyline moving to The Elder Scrolls Online base game, two new Solo Dungeons, new rewards to unlock with the Season Two Tamriel Tome, Golden Pursuit campaigns, in-game events, and the next wave of player-experience improvements. 

The Elder Scrolls Online Season Two is live from today, October 21, 2026, until January 27, 2027.
title: The Elder Scrolls Online - Official Welcome to Season Two Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Grobnopolis: Last Days in this new trailer for the upcoming slow, oppressive atmospheric horror experience where curiosity is both compass and curse. The sun is gone. The mines are bleeding. Walk the dying city of Huta-Grobno, tune into forbidden broadcasts and survive the last days of a world rotting under the clouds. Grobnopolis: Last Days will be available on Steam and Xbox on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Grobnopolis: Last Days - Official Demo Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: When Bento, an amateur documentarian vanishes, three strangers are drawn to the Drowned Lake to find him. As the lake’s dark past comes to light, so do the secrets buried deep within them. Explore, survive, and investigate the dark waters in this fishing survival horror game. Watch the chilling new trailer for Drowned Lake ahead of the game's launch on Steam and Xbox Series X/S. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Drowned Lake - Official Demo Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Cucina Stellata, a psychological horror game. Cook traditional 19th-century Italian recipes in a kitchen haunted by hunger. A short psychological horror where gastronomy, ritual and cosmic appetite share the same table. Cucina Stellata is available now on Steam. It is coming soon to Xbox on PC.
title: Cucina Stellata - Official Launch Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Fathom Reach, an upcoming solo roguelike deckbuilder game under the sea. Chain card combos and risk deeper dives for more loot. Bring the haul home to grow your deck and build a base that fights while you're away. Fathom Reach will be available on PC on November 3, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Fathom Reach - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: In a universe where memories are harvested from mortals and sold as sentient books to celestial consumers, one day, production stops. God is gone and a lowly librarian, and his reluctant sidekick Memo are tasked to investigate. Burden Street Station is a narrative-driven adventure about memory, grief, and community. Explore a liminal world where personalities shape dialogues and help lost souls find themselves, as you uncover the cosmic tragedy that derailed your cozy work life! Take a look at the world of Burden Street Station in this latest trailer. Burden Street Station is out now on Steam. It is coming soon to Xbox on PC.
title: Burden Street Station - Official Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Teaser Trailer for Serious Sam: The Third Encounter, the next entry in the hit arcade first-person shooter series developed by Croteam. Players will embark on a violent adventure in the deep reaches of space to take on new enemies, wield bigger guns, and overcome lethal odds by any means necessary. Serious Sam: The Third Encounter is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Season 19 Overview Trailer for SnowRunner, an off-road driving simulation game developed by Saber Interactive. Players will take on the new region of the Swiss Alps to overcome new snowy maps, get behind the wheel of the Wortek 250T & Derry Savior, and more with Season 19 Research & Restore. Season 19 is available now for SnowRunner on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).
title: SnowRunner - Official Season 19 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Test your luck. Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck! Get another look at Buckshot Roulette in this new trailer. Buckshot Roulette is coming soon to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 (PS4), and PlayStation 5 (PS5. It is available now on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Game Pass.
title: Buckshot Roulette - Official Console Announce Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Being & Becoming is an atmospheric metroidvania, set in a dying kingdom held together only by the collective dream of thousands of would-be martyrs. Fate itself is against you as The Word’s prophecy unfolds. Rewrite your place within The Word or become a scripted part of this horrible revelation. Check out the latest Being & Becoming trailer to see gameplay and learn more about the story. Being & Becoming will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox on PC in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Being & Becoming - Official Demo Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Eggs: perfection in two parts. The simple whites. The sublime yolk. Each the lesser without its partner. Chorus and verse. A symphony of flavor. The catchy tune reminding us of warm baths and late-night movies. The elevator music to whatever lies beyond. Check out the Arctic Eggs trailer for this physics-and-patience-driven frying sim. Arctic Eggs is coming soon to Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 (PS5). It is out now on PC and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Arctic Eggs - Official Console Announce Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: amFM is a dimension-hopping and contraption-building surreal RPG. Watch the amFM trailer for a peek at its world and more. In amFM, switch dimensions at any time and build elaborate mechanisms to destroy your foes in creative ways. Adapt your machines to withstand the protests of your unwilling test subjects. Clean up this unmaterial broth of suffering. amFM will be available on Steam and Xbox Series X/S.
title: amFM - Official Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at gameplay and more from Altered Alma in this trailer for the upcoming Metroidvania with RPG elements and dating sim features. Altered Alma will be available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and PC (Steam). A demo is out now on Steam.

Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cyberpunk cityscape, Neo Barcelona awaits!
title: Altered Alma - Official Demo Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Haunted Horizon Halloween 2026 Trailer for World of Tanks: HEAT, a free-to-play tank action shooter developed by Wargaming Group Limited. Players will experience the frights and scares of the season with two free Halloween Battle Passes, vehicle skins, and more to ring in the season. The Haunted Horizon Halloween 2026 event is available now through November 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Official Haunted Horizon Halloween 2026 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, a real-time strategy game developed by King Art. Players will get the rundown on all there is to experience on the front lines of a galactic war, with 70 missions to take on, four factions, and four different campaigns along the way. Make key decisions on the battlefield and take the fight to multiplayer in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, launching on December 3 for PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official Game Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Half Grip in this trailer for the brutal one-handed roguelike combat racing game where every action could end in a crash. Steer, shoot and reload - each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail. Half Grip will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Half Grip - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
We Were Here Tomorrow is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam. Watch the launch trailer for We Were Here Tomorrow, a co-op puzzle adventure game from developer Total Mayhem Games. 

In We Were Here Tomorrow, you and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow.
title: We Were Here Tomorrow - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The galaxy just got a lot more crowded. Take another look at gameplay and more from Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon in this latest trailer for the upcoming sci-fi roguelike turn-based RPG with tactical combat. Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon will be available on PC. An updated demo is out now on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest from October 19 to October 26, 2026. 

The updated demo features a new global map, hex capture, new loot system, manual module control, new trading ship type, save/load, autosave and quick save, and a freeride mode. 

In Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon, become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings a new adventure. Space shows no mercy.
title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon - Official Updated Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Halloween comes to the Forest Escape: Last Train. Check out the latest trailer for Forest Escape: Last Train to see what to expect with the Cursed Abbey update for the co-op horror game. Forest Escape: Last Train is available in Early Access on PC, and the Cursed Abbey update is available now until October 31, 2026.

Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op surreal horror game for 1–4 players. Explore bizarre nightmare locations, gather resources, solve the insane Warden's twisted puzzles, and keep your locomotive running as you fight to escape his unhinged world.
title: Forest Escape: Last Train - Official Cursed Abbey Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the features of Crimson Desert's upcoming Charting the Unknown DLC in this new trailer for the open-world action-adventure RPG. The new trailer showcases what awaits in the Charting the Unknown DLC, including new stories, ocean voyages, underwater exploration, ship building, establishing strongholds, deeper relationships with certain characters across Pywel, business management and expanded housing. 

In Charting the Unknown, the stories of the main characters, Kliff, Damiane and Oongka, continue as each sets out to forge their own path. Along the way, they will encounter allies and threats, both old and new, as they chart their own course forward.

Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store on October 29, 2026 at 22:00 UTC | 23:00 CEST.

#CrimsonDesert #Gaming #IGN
title: Crimson Desert - Official Charting the Unknown DLC: Features Overview Trailer
